title: Secure this reader
description: Moves this reader to the secure firmware: afterwards it only runs firmware signed by this installation and its storage is encrypted.
loading: Checking whether this reader can be secured…
noSigningKey: No signing key for this reader
noSigningKeyHint: The server holds no key this reader trusts, so it gets no more updates. Restore the signing key backup or the recovery file under Settings → Reader security.

blocker.missing-permission: You need the permission to manage system settings.
blocker.not-hardware-tested: The secure firmware of this reader variant has not been verified on hardware yet.
blocker.no-secure-image: There is no secure firmware for this reader variant.
blocker.recovery-check-missing: Check the recovery key under Settings → Reader security first.
blocker.no-secure-conversion: The reader's firmware cannot be secured yet. Update it first.
blocker.not-release-build: The reader runs a development build.
blocker.demo-or-debug-variant: The reader runs a demo or debug build.
blocker.not-plain-profile: The reader already runs a secure or lab build.
blocker.digests-differ: The reader has keys of another key set burned in.
blocker.conversion-running: Another reader is being secured right now.

risk.title: Secure this reader?
risk.intro: Securing changes the reader permanently. Read this before you continue:
risk.brickWindows: There are two short periods (writing the bootloader, then turning on Secure Boot and encrypting the flash) in which a power loss can make the reader unusable.
risk.power: Keep the reader powered for the whole run and make sure nobody unplugs it.
risk.noFlashing: Afterwards the reader can no longer be flashed from the browser or over USB.
risk.signedOnly: It only accepts updates signed by this installation.
risk.noMove: Moving the reader to another installation is not supported.
risk.backup: Keep the signing key backup, the recovery key with their passphrases, the database and AUTH_SESSION_SECRET backed up. Without them the reader may never be updated again.

start.title: Secure {{name}}
start.typeName: Type the reader's name to confirm
start.preflightHint: The preflight only reads from the reader; nothing is changed yet.
start.preflightFailed: A check failed. The reader cannot be secured.

progress.offline: The reader is offline. The run continues when it is back.
progress.dontUnplugHint: The reader is in a critical step. Losing power now can make it unusable.
progress.cancelMessage: The reader deletes what it downloaded and keeps running its current firmware.

failure.title: Securing failed
failure.transfer-failed: The transfer of the secure firmware failed.
failure.verify-failed: The reader could not verify the signed firmware.
failure.burn-refused: The reader refused to burn the keys.
failure.digest-mismatch: Key mismatch: the reader reported different key fingerprints than the server recorded.
failure.migration-failed: The secure firmware could not migrate the pairing and settings.
failure.efuse-check-failed: The reader's security report did not pass the check after securing.
failure.no-signing-key: No signing key for this reader
failure.image-unavailable: The secure firmware for this reader is not available.
failure.reader-changed: The reader's pairing changed during the run.
failure.protocol-error: The reader sent an unexpected answer.

interrupted.title: Interrupted
interrupted.message: The reader has been offline for more than 15 minutes after the bootloader was written. It may have lost power in a critical window. Bring it back online; if it reconnects, the run continues. If it does not, it probably needs to be replaced.
